question: Which of the following is a performing art from the state of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lavani**.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lavani **is a folk dance of Maharashtra.
 
• Women wearing ankle bells (Ghungroo) and 9-yard saree perform this dance on dholak beats.
 
• The performers are called 'Nauvari' and the style of saree wearing is called Kashta.
 
• It is performed on the themes of heroism, love devotion, sorrow, politics, or religion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
